The pair is named only in the paragraph that follows. Prose only, and the log it cites is correct.

justifications.durability: tests/test_crew_promotion.py:613 asserts exit_code == 1 and :622 asserts the per-run file is absent, so restoring the swallowed `{"status": "failed"}` return in reckon/ledger.py:_index_append reddens both; the assertions compare the command's own result and the filesystem, not a value the test supplied.
